svg.title: How it fits together
svg.desc: Source systems lands in Raw layer; Raw layer transformed by Data Marts Core; Data Marts Core builds Data marts; Data marts defined in Orca Semantics; Orca Semantics gives meaning to Orca; Data marts queried as the signed-in person Orca; Orca Semantics certified metrics for Orca Visuals; Orca answers The company; Orca Visuals dashboards for The company; Data Foundation Plan sets the roadmap for everything below Data Marts Core.

g.text: SETS THE ROADMAP FOR EVERYTHING BELOW
the strategy the executive committee adopted
one Terraform estate for the company
grants with a reason and an audit trail
spend and anomalies on every project
tests and alerts routed to owners
